transcript: The proposal artifact is canonically serialised as JSON with recursive sorted keys and no whitespace, persisted verbatim as proposal_canon.json; a third party can re-derive hProposal by computing sha256sum proposal_canon.json, obtaining ee462bf0af3190a7eecd36d719ded53fed2e2db20f45ea85e82cfd87154c2aab, and then re-derive the seed by computing sha256 over the concatenation of hProposal and the salt 46ec7d5fcb47f5eee59610f999d457f7b299cb590fc8b33cb866012f02b6c0cd, yielding the seedHex recorded above, from which the census draw of all 62 witnesses of census.json, in order, is deterministic and without replacement.
